name: App Store listing rules
description: What an iOS listing of this app must never say, and where its copy lives, checked before anything is sent to App Store Connect.

spec.summary: Guards the App Store listing against the rejections that cost the most time: words Apple refuses in an iOS listing, and where the copy files are.

params.label: Words the iOS listing must not contain
params.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive. Guideline 2.3.10: no other platform in the listing.

instructions.*:
The listing scripts refuse to send copy that breaks these, before the first request:

- **Guideline 2.3.10** — an iOS listing may not name another platform. A description shared with Google Play usually has a line about Android: the iOS copy must not.
- **Guideline 1.5** — the support URL must reach a page that answers without signing in (`support_url.txt` is required per locale).
- **Guideline 3.1.2** — an app selling subscriptions needs its terms (Apple's standard EULA or your own) linked from the description or the EULA field; keep it when editing.

Add any other word your listing must avoid, and change the copy folder if yours is elsewhere.
